Index of an article's tables, by element id

Source: R/html-scrape.R
html_table_index.Rd

PMC wraps each table in a <section id="TabN"> carrying its own number (.obj_head) and caption (.caption) – this lists all of them, so a table's id can be looked up before reading it with html_read_table(), just as pdf_table_index() does for PDF tables.

Usage

html_table_index(html_file)

Arguments

html_file

Path or URL to the article's HTML page.

Value

A data frame with columns id, label (e.g. "Table 1.") and caption.
